services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Get ready for an unforgettable summer of hands-on exploration, curiosity-driven learning, and exciting discoveries! Our 2026 Summer Camps invite campers ages 3 to 12 to dive into engaging STEM themes including Structures & Bridges, Ecology, and Flight & Aerodynamics, as well as our inclusive STEM4U Adaptive Camps designed for learners of all abilities. Campers will build confidence, collaborate with peers, and develop real-world problem-solving skills in a supportive environment that celebrates curiosity and creativity. services.name: Preschool Programs
services.desc: Enroll your children ages 3 to 5 in our innovative STEM Preschool program where play-based, hands-on learning is at the heart of everything we do. Our program is designed for children who have turned 3 by September 2nd and are fully potty-trained. Our activities are designed to be engaging and fun, allowing children to explore and discover at their own pace.
